name: alphacode
description: Free MIT AI coding agent — no API key needed. Built-in free model, or bring Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama +50 more. Swarm mode, 40+ tools, browser & desktop automation, built in Rust.

paragraphs: A terminal-first AI coding agent that can understand a codebase, edit files, run commands and tests, automate Firefox, control desktop applications, and verify its work.
Get started · Documentation · Releases · Report a bug · Firefox Browser Agent

AlphaCode is an open-source AI coding agent built in Rust. Instead of only suggesting code in a chat, it can work in your development environment: inspect a repository, plan a task, edit files, run commands and tests, use web tools, operate a real Firefox session, interact with desktop applications, and report what it verified.
features: Use AlphaCode to explore an unfamiliar codebase, trace a bug, refactor a module, add a feature, run a build, create regression tests, review a diff, or investigate a failure.

requirements.text: The built-in free AI lane lets you get started without configuring an API key; connected providers may require their own credentials and may incur charges.
You can also run alphacode login from your shell or /login inside AlphaCode.
OpenAI Codex OAuth: AlphaCode uses a local callback at during sign-in.
Credentials: remove exported APIKEY variables and revoke provider API keys or OAuth grants you no longer need.
